POL-1.1.title: Credential storage
POL-1.1.text: Passwords must be stored only as salted hashes (bcrypt or argon2). Plaintext credential columns are prohibited.

POL-1.2.title: Sensitive identifiers
POL-1.2.text: National ID numbers and similar identifiers must be encrypted at rest.

POL-2.1.title: Referential integrity
POL-2.1.text: Audit and log tables must reference their subject (for example a user) through an enforced foreign key.

POL-2.2.title: Audit log fields
POL-2.2.text: Audit logs must carry typed UTC timestamps and must not be editable by application roles.

POL-3.1.title: Backups
POL-3.1.text: Backups must be encrypted and tracked with an enforced encryption flag.

POL-3.2.title: Retention
POL-3.2.text: Every table holding personal data must define a retention period.
